exposure: Previous delivery mode (Cesarean section or vaginal delivery)
cohort: 36,355 multiparous women from a Chinese birth registry
finding: Compared to women with previous vaginal delivery, those with a previous cesarean delivery had significantly higher risks of various adverse pregnancy outcomes, including cesarean section, postpartum complications, and adverse neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with a previous cesarean delivery had a higher incidence of cesarean section in their subsequent pregnancy.
